segments.OBA.1.1-2: The LORD will make Edom small among the nations
segments.OBA.1.3-4: The LORD will bring proud Edom down from the heights
segments.OBA.1.5-6: Edom will be robbed worse than by thieves
segments.OBA.1.7-9: Allies will betray Edom and its wise men will fall
segments.OBA.1.10-11: Edom will be shamed for standing aside when Jacob suffered
segments.OBA.1.12-14: Edom should not have gloated when Judah was in trouble
segments.OBA.1.15-16: The Day of the LORD is near for all nations
segments.OBA.1.17-18: Zion will be safe, and Edom will be destroyed
segments.OBA.1.19-19: Israel will take the lands of Edom and the Philistines
segments.OBA.1.20-21: Israel’s exiles will take new land, and the LORD will rule
